meta.title: Request a Time | BC Glass & Tint
meta.description: Ask for a time at BC Glass and Tint in Boulder City. Send your name, number and what you need, and someone from the shop confirms your time.

hero.heading: Request a time.
hero.lead: Tell us what you need and when you are free. Someone from the shop confirms your time by call or text from {phone}. Nothing is booked until we confirm.
hero.lead_calls_only: Tell us what you need and when you are free. Someone from the shop calls you from {phone} to confirm your time. Nothing is booked until we confirm.

form.phone_label: Phone, so we can confirm your time
form.details_hint: Vehicle, windows or rooms. Please leave out insurance, medical and license numbers.
form.build_note: Your build is filled in below. Change anything that is not right.
form.build_price: Price for this build: {total}. We confirm the exact price before anything is booked.
form.build_price_none: We confirm the exact price on the call.
form.days_limit: That is two days. Uncheck one to pick a different time.
form.phone_error: Enter a phone number with area code.
form.send_error: That did not send. Check your signal and try again, or call us at {phone}, {hours}.
